card.fires_on: Words right before or inside a brand drug name, such as the start of Mylanta, Tylenol or Tuxarin, or lead-in words like 'popular brands' and 'ibuprofen in'. It also fires on a few other spots in drug text.

modes.description: A word that introduces a named product or a list of brands.
